title: Pot with its lid on
description: The lid clicked on: its top on the pot's rim and the bead in the groove, clear all round by the printer's fit, so neither part is strained at rest.

fits.note: The lid, on its annular snap: its top rests on the rim, and the bead passes 0.2 mm into the skirt as it snaps on (the undercut annularSnapModel sizes)
